run_eval_bleu: run a sacrebleu evaluation command and parse the BLEU score from the output
check_data_test_bleu: check if multilingual test data matches sacrebleu reference sets for given language pairs
run_check_iswlt_test_data: run the script to validate IWSLT test data against sacrebleu reference datasets
refactor_run_eval_bleu: refactor run_eval_bleu to support additional BLEU score formats or output parsers
